name: Havells India Ltd
title: Havells India Ltd - 517354 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volumes soft on channel destocking and mild summer; cables volume +6% with 14% value growth on price, but no FY27 guidance and management refused to quantify outlook.

utilisation.quote: we've been still operating at high -capacity utilization

capex.peers_comment: A large cement-group player has preponed its entry into housing wires; management said new players will gain some share.
capex.quote: by '27-'28 major capex would go into cables and wires which is already panned out

triggers.label: Lloyd price hikes 8% to 15%
triggers.quote: It ranges between at least 8% to 15% depending upon the AC

triggers.label: Large cement-group entrant into wires
triggers.quote: They have preponed their entry into the housing wire market by a quarter or two.

triggers.label: Fans and ACs degrown for full year
triggers.quote: fans, we have degrown in the entire year. Fans, ACs and air coolers, there we have degrown.

triggers.label: Lloyd channel inventory to normalise by April-end
triggers.quote: hopefully, by the end of this month, there will be normalized inventories at the channel level as well.

guidance.quote: it is very difficult to say what the growth will be
that remains as is because we are continuing to wanting to be more efficient

red_flags.label: Lloyd capital barely earning returns
red_flags.quote: we have about INR4,000 crores of capital now deployed in Lloyd, which at this stage is barely generating any profitability

red_flags.label: Q4 cables margin lifted by inventory gains
red_flags.quote: overall, there were inventory gains because of copper and aluminum as well.

evasions.quote: At this point of time, it is very difficult to say what the growth will be.

evasions.topic: Lloyd price hikes needed to restore margin

evasions.quote: Generally, we don't give product -wise growth rates
